domain: llm-inference decode TPOT (TP2 graph runner, local harness)
question: Does the opt-in decode round-4 candidate (--fp8-config gemv-bk512, M=1 GEMV BLOCK_K 256->512) beat the current shipped defaults (graph + graph scale-cache on + M=1 FP8 GEMV, --fp8-config gemv) exactly and faster?
git_head_note: HEAD is the rounds 2-3 integration commit (graph scale-cache default + GEMV FP8 default). The gemv-bk512 candidate is UNCOMMITTED working-tree code (dirty files listed below; pre-existing dirty prefill-s2 files also present and untouched). benchmarks/harness/decode_round3.json + summary are the prior round. This round edits no source and commits nothing.

candidates.R4B_base_gemv: --decode-mode graph --scale-cache on --fp8-config gemv (current shipped defaults; M1_GEMV_CONFIG BLOCK_N=16 BLOCK_K=256 num_warps=4 num_stages=3)

command_environment.shapes: batch A: all 3 recorded probes (capital, water, counting) x32 greedy in one torchrun; batch B: capital x128 greedy (--probe capital --max-new-tokens 128).
command_environment.ordering: ABBA per batch: B,C,C,B,B,C; 3 measured runs per candidate per shape; no runs discarded.
command_environment.exactness_x32: runner vs_bridge (ours_pipeline_fastfp8.json) and vs_arm_a (recorded Arm A probe ids), full 32/32 required, logits finite.
command_environment.exactness_x128: references hold only 32 ids, so x128 exactness = 32/32 prefix vs both references plus full 128/128 agreement against the first base (B) x128 run.
command_environment.kernel_smoke: .venv-gpu/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_fp8_triton_gpu.py -k bk512 -q -> 5 passed, 22 deselected (run before benchmarks; GPUs idle).

selection_rule.rule: Zero tolerance: any inexact candidate run rejects the candidate regardless of speed. Otherwise BECOME DEFAULT only if exact everywhere AND aggregate-median-faster AND no shape median regresses by more than 1%; else REMAIN OPT-IN (REJECTED if inexact).
selection_rule.recommendation: BECOME DEFAULT — exact everywhere, aggregate-faster, and no shape regresses by more than 1%.

vllm_win_claim: NO — candidate aggregate median 22.112 ms is not below the Arm A 20.3 ms bar (and the 19.17 ms roofline floor); no beating-vLLM suite claim. Arm B remains separate.
